$comment: ADR-051 license-gate elections. The /ship `licenses` phase (scripts/license-gate.mjs) goes RED when any package in package-lock.json resolves an AGPL / SSPL / BUSL / Elastic / GPL-only license, unless the package has an election here. Elections are for: (a) dual-licensed packages electing their permissive branch, (b) packages with no published license field (documented exceptions, noted in the SBOM). Every entry REQUIRES a human 'reason' — a reasonless entry fails allowlist validation. Waiving a TRUE (non-dual) copyleft/source-available license additionally needs a SECURITY.md §12 row with sign-off (ADR-051 migration trigger). MPL-2.0 is NOT in the deny set: file-level weak copyleft consumed unmodified (axe-core, lightningcss — dev/build only) carries no obligation for this template (ADR-051).

jszip.reason: dual-licensed (MIT OR GPL-3.0-or-later); MIT elected per ADR-051. Transitive via exceljs; the tracked exceljs->SheetJS migration (ADR-051 §4) prunes this subtree.

buffers.reason: no license field published (pre-SPDX-era leaf util, transitive); documented exception per ADR-051, noted in the SBOM.

seq-queue.reason: no license field published (pre-SPDX-era leaf util, transitive); documented exception per ADR-051, noted in the SBOM.

ssh2.reason: no `license` field in package.json but ships a verbatim MIT LICENSE file (Brian White/mscdex). DEV-only transitive via @testcontainers/postgresql -> testcontainers -> dockerode -> ssh2 (V2-401); never in the runtime bundle. Documented exception per ADR-051.

cpu-features.reason: no `license` field but ships a verbatim MIT LICENSE file (mscdex). DEV-only transitive via ssh2 (V2-401 testcontainers); documented exception per ADR-051.

buildcheck.reason: no `license` field but ships a verbatim MIT LICENSE file (mscdex). DEV-only transitive via ssh2 (V2-401 testcontainers); documented exception per ADR-051.

pizzip.reason: dual-licensed (MIT OR GPL-3.0); MIT elected per ADR-051 — the same election as jszip, from which PizZip is forked. RUNTIME dependency of the JML leaver documents (ADR-083): docxtemplater takes a caller-supplied zip. Its dependency pako is MIT AND Zlib (both permissive).

png-js.reason: no `license` field in package.json but ships a verbatim MIT LICENSE file (Devon Govett). Runtime transitive via @react-pdf/renderer (ADR-084, server-only offer letter). Documented exception per ADR-051.
